prompt: # Plan { "intent": "Load orders incrementally into Silver, deduplicating to one current row per order_id using newest updated_at", "layer": "silver", "strategy"
text:
```json
{
  "parameters": [
    "orders_table",
    "target_table",
    "watermark",
    "key_columns"
  ],
  "cells": [
    {
      "title": "Read incremental orders using watermark filter",
      "code": "from pyspark.sql import functions as F

watermark_epoch = int(watermark)

bronze_orders = (
    spark.read.table(orders_table)
    .filter(F.col("updated_at") > watermark_epoch)
    .select(
        F.col("order_id").cast("string"),
        F.col("customer_id").cast("string"),
        F.col("order_status").cast("string"),
        F.col("purchased_at").cast("bigint"),
        F.col("delivered_at").cast("bigint"),
        F.col("updated_at").cast("bigint"),
    )
)",
      "cites": [
        "pattern:module.transform-silver",
        "table:orders",
        "standard:notebook.explicit-schemas-and-column-lists",
        "standard:notebook.configuration-comes-from-metadata-never-literals"
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Deduplicate incoming orders batch keeping latest updated_at",
      "code": "from pyspark.sql.window import Window
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

keys = [k.strip() for k in key_columns.split(",")]

window_spec = Window.partitionBy(*keys).orderBy(F.col("updated_at").desc())

deduplicated_orders = (
    bronze_orders
    .withColumn("_row_num", F.row_number().over(window_spec))
    .filter(F.col("_row_num") == 1)
    .drop("_row_num")
)",
      "cites": [
        "pattern:module.transform-silver",
        "standard:notebook.silver-keeps-one-current-row-per-key",
        "standard:notebook.configuration-comes-from-metadata-never-literals"
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Validate quality rules on deduplicated batch",
      "code": "from pyspark.sql import functions as F

# Validate non-null primary keys and required fields prior to writing
valid_orders = deduplicated_orders.filter(
    F.col("order_id").isNotNull() & F.col("updated_at").isNotNull()
)",
      "cites": [
        "standard:notebook.quality-rules-run-before-writes"
      ]
    },
    {
      "title": "Upsert deduplicated orders into Silver target via Delta MERGE",
      "code": "from delta.tables import DeltaTable

keys = [k.strip() for k in key_columns.split(",")]
merge_condition = " AND ".join([f"target.{k} = source.{k}" for k in keys])

silver_target = DeltaTable.forName(spark, target_table)

(
    silver_target.alias("target")
    .merge(
        valid_orders.alias("source"),
        merge_condition
    )
    .whenMatchedUpdateAll()
    .whenNotMatchedInsertAll()
    .execute()
)",
      "cites": [
        "pattern:module.transform-silver",
        "standard:notebook.writes-are-idempotent",
        "standard:notebook.silver-keeps-one-current-row-per-key",
        "standard:notebook.configuration-comes-from-metadata-never-literals"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```
